requirement.statement: The project SHALL independently verify G15-G17 with executable Bun and .NET evidence, preserving only the frozen D6-D8 intentional boundaries.

case.given: the completed registry lifecycle track and separate Bun and .NET OM runtime instances
case.when: the verifier exercises registration, clear/reset, isolation, and in-flight callback observation
case.then: each runtime SHALL retain instance-local callback facts while persisted definitions and binding identities remain intact

case.given: the completed Bun portability track and the C# V1 catalog contract
case.when: the verifier evaluates manifest round-trip, binding identity, restart, rebind, unresolved, and ready states
case.then: both implementations SHALL expose compatible durable metadata and fail closed for unresolved executable callbacks

case.given: a Bun behavior-aware schema snapshot and a legacy snapshot lacking its behavior section
case.when: the verifier evaluates snapshot, keyed diff, migration, rollback, readiness reprojection, and D8 policies
case.then: all persisted behavior relations and binding identities SHALL be covered without persisting executable source, and the legacy default SHALL reject with zero effects
